integrity: The proof reconstructs the equality conditions in the focal source's square expansions. Even orders force both vanishing of the square operator and vanishing tangential gradient; odd orders force radiality directly from the vector square equation. Radial ODE uniqueness then identifies the published confluent-hypergeometric profile. No finite numerical experiment is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to nondegenerate real extremizers with a smooth derived profile in the natural square graph domain, and to \(N\ge2\), \(m\ge3\). It determines \(P_{m-2}u\), not an arbitrary representative of \(u\) modulo the seminorm null space. No quantitative stability statement is claimed.
title: Rigidity of higher-order Heisenberg extremizers at the square-profile level
